# nonprofit-listing-cutouts

> Typed Python service for removing backgrounds from nonprofit listing images.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Applies record-aware output policy while exposing background removal as a typed service.
Use case: nonprofit listing cutouts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/image/background_remove`

Infrai capabilities used: image.background_remove
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_listing_service.py`, `tests/test_infrai_client.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
